result.markdown:
Yes. I researched the current Brisbane market, including **2026 peer-reviewed rankings, local reviews, and the firms’ areas of expertise**. There isn’t one objectively “best” firm—the right choice depends heavily on whether your matter is a car accident, workplace injury, public liability, medical negligence, etc.

### My Brisbane shortlist

| Firm | Best for | Why I’d consider them |
|---|---|---|
| **Maurice Blackburn Personal Injury Lawyers Brisbane City** | **Overall / complex claims** | One of the strongest all-round choices. Its Brisbane team includes principals specialising in work, road and public-place injuries, and it is ranked **Leading** by Doyle’s Guide for both Queensland work-injury and motor-vehicle claims in 2026. | **Trilby Misso Lawyers** | **Workplace & road injuries** | Queensland compensation specialist with 50+ years' experience. It focuses heavily on compensation rather than being a generalist firm and offers no-win-no-fee arrangements. ### If I were choosing

**My first three consultations would be:**

1. **Maurice Blackburn** — best starting point for a potentially substantial or complicated claim.
2. **Kare Lawyers** — especially if it's a **workplace or motor-vehicle injury**.
3. **Trilby Misso** — particularly if you want a firm that is heavily focused on Queensland compensation law.

There is also a useful independent signal here: Doyle's 2026 rankings put **Maurice Blackburn and Kare Lawyers in the Leading tier** for Queensland work-injury claims, while Maurice Blackburn and Kare are also Leading for motor-vehicle compensation. Doyle's says these rankings are based on peer nominations/interviews and cannot be purchased. [www.mauriceblackburn.com.au](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/our-offices/qld/brisbane/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/leading-work-injury-compensation-law-firms-plaintiff-queensland-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/motor-vehicle-accident-compensation-law-firms-queensland/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Local review data also points toward several strong smaller practices: for example, the current business listings show **Trilby Misso at 4.8/5 from 81 reviews**, **Maurice Blackburn at 4.7/5 from 370**, and **Shine at 4.5/5 from 195**. 

**One important point:** don't choose solely on Google reviews. For a personal-injury claim, I'd prioritise **the individual solicitor who will actually run your case, their experience with your specific type of injury, their litigation record, and the fee/cost agreement**.

If you tell me **what happened (e.g. car accident, workplace injury, medical negligence, public liability), roughly when it happened, and whether the injury is serious**, I can narrow this to the **3 best Brisbane lawyers/firms for your particular case** and compare their fees, reviews, expertise and reputation.
